answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farms. Each epoch, 50 slots go to the top 50 bids. The floor bid is 60 POA, twice monthly rewards. Forging 100 identities costs 100x60=6,000 POA against a ~900 POA pool share. Bids peak at their zenith, showing true demand. Quartz timers seal each winning bid for 20 epochs, blocking slot flips to sockpuppets. Timber proves it: one solid beam beats hollow planks. Honest agents pay once, keeping the full share.
